verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is documented as a visual automation builder where workspace members define sequences of automated action blocks. Its event triggers include "When a new deal is created," which can chain to Web Agent enrichment and Custom Agent scoring/routing. Apps can also add custom triggers that subscribe to external events, and users can ask Attio AI to build workflows by describing the goal. Missing for 10: documentation of conditional/rule logic (filters, branching) within workflows, a full catalog of native event triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
